name: BT node dictionary
caption: Dictionary for interpreting behavior control and modification
source: From robotic mission descriptions to specifications: there and back again (ICSE 2026)

placeholders.[Action]: a child node name; if it is a standard ROS action, controller or decorator, refer to it as ROS action [name], else as custom action [name].
placeholders.[Actions]: a series of child node names, listed by name.
placeholders.[Condition]: a check that returns success, rendered as [condition ID] is true.
placeholders.[!Condition]: a check that returns failure, rendered as [condition ID] is false.
placeholders.[Subtree ID]: the ID of a referenced behavior tree, rendered as subtree [ID].
placeholders.[port:name]: the literal value of the node's name XML attribute, rendered as follows. An integer appears verbatim (up to 5 attempts). A value of -1 is rendered by its meaning rather than quoted: for an attempt, retry or cycle count as the unbounded reading (indefinitely), and for a Parallel threshold as all children. A blackboard remapping \texttt{{key}} is rendered as a value read from [key] at runtime, never silently dropped. When the attribute is absent, the node's documented default is stated and named as a default (the default of 1 retry). Durations may be converted to the unit a reader expects, so delay_msec="1000" may be rendered as 1 second.

entries.label: Sequence
entries.description: Execute a series of child nodes in order from left to right.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails.

entries.label: SequenceWithMemory, SequenceStar
entries.description: Execute a series of child nodes in order, from left to right, remembering which ones have already succeeded.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) in sequence. If an action fails, stop the sequence; on the next execution, resume from the failed action without repeating the actions that already succeeded.

entries.label: Delay
entries.description: Wait for a given duration before executing the associated child node.
entries.template: Wait for the specified delay, then execute [Action] and return its result.

entries.label: PipelineSequence
entries.description: Execute a series of child nodes in order from left to right and advance on running or success.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. While an action is running or has succeeded, go to the next action.

entries.label: ConditionalSequence
entries.description: Execute a series of child nodes in order from left to right and re-check a condition for each node.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) in order while checking a condition for each action. If [Condition] move to the next action. Else if [!Condition], end the sequence.

entries.label: WhileDoElse
entries.description: Execute a node while a condition is true else execute and alternative node if that same condition fails.
entries.template: While [Condition], do [Action]. If [!Condition], execute the alternative.

entries.label: Loop
entries.description: Repeatedly execute a child node for a specified number of iterations, until a specific status is returned or forever.
entries.template: Execute [Action] continuously until it fails or succeeds. Else keep executing [Action] forever.

entries.label: Fallback
entries.description: Execute child nodes sequentially from left to right, until one succeeds or all fail.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) consecutively. If any action ([Action]) fails, move to the next action until an action succeeds. If no action succeeds, the execution fails.

entries.label: FallbackStar
entries.description: Execute child nodes sequentially from left to right, until one succeeds. If all fail retry again from the beginning.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) consecutively. If any action ([Action]) fails, move to the next action until an action succeeds. If no action succeeds, start all over again until an action succeeds.

entries.label: ForceSuccess
entries.description: Force child node to succeed regardless of the conditions.
entries.template: Execute [Action] and make sure it always succeeds.

entries.label: ForceFailure
entries.description: Force child node to fail regardless of the conditions.
entries.template: Execute [Action] and make sure it always fails.

entries.label: RepeatUntilSuccess
entries.description: Repeatedly execute child node until its successful.
entries.template: Continuously execute [Action] until it succeeds.

entries.label: Retry
entries.description: Re-execute a child node for either a fixed number of times or until its successful.
entries.template: Execute [Action]. If it fails, re-execute it either for a specified number of times or until it succeeds.

entries.label: ReactiveSequence
entries.description: Execute a series of child nodes in sequence. While a node is running, re-evaluate previous child nodes.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) in sequence. If [Action] fails, stop execution. While [Action] is still running, re-evaluate previous actions.

entries.label: ReactiveFallback
entries.description: Execute a series of child nodes in order from left to right. While a later node is running, restart evaluation from node 0.
entries.template: Execute the following actions [Actions] in order. If [Action] succeeds, stop execution. Else keep executing and re-evaluating previous actions whenever an action is running.

entries.label: Repeat
entries.description: Execute a set of child nodes multiple times.
entries.template: Execute [Action] for a set number of times or infinitely.

entries.label: Inverter
entries.description: Negate a the execution outcome of a child node.
entries.template: Execute inverted [Action]. If [Action] succeeds, reverse it to fail. Else if [Action] fails, reverse it to succeed.

entries.label: KeepRunningUntilFailure
entries.description: Keep executing child node as long as it does not fail.
entries.template: Execute [Action]. If [Action] succeeds, restart it. Else if [Action] fails, stop looping and continue execution.

entries.label: Switch (Switch2–Switch6)
entries.description: Execute child node based on blackboard value.
entries.template: Read blackboard value and compare it against a set of cases. If a case matches the blackboard value, execute corresponding [Action]. Else if no case matches, execute default [Action].

entries.label: Parallel, ParallelNode
entries.description: Execute multiple child nodes simultaneously, ensuring all are completed successfully.
entries.template: Execute the following actions ([Actions]) simultaneously. If either a success threshold is reached or all actions succeed, the execution was successful. Else if any action fails, the execution fails.

entries.label: BlackboardCheckValue (Int, Double, String)
entries.description: Check whether a value stored on the blackboard matches the expected value.
entries.template: Find a value on the blackboard and check if it matches a given rule.

entries.label: RetryUntilSuccessful, RetryUntilSuccesful
entries.description: Continuously try to re-execute a child node until it succeeds, up to a bounded number of attempts.
entries.template: Execute [Action]. If it fails, re-execute it up to [port:num_attempts] attempts in total. If it has still not succeeded, the execution fails. If [port:num_attempts] is -1, keep retrying indefinitely.

entries.label: RecoveryNode
entries.description: Try to run the primary child node. If it fails, run the next child node to recover and try the primary child node again, for a bounded number of retries.
entries.template: Execute main [Action]. If it fails, execute recovery action ([Action]), then retry main [Action]. Repeat this recovery-and-retry cycle up to [port:number_of_retries] times. If main [Action] still has not succeeded after that many retries, or if recovery action ([Action]) fails, stop execution.

entries.label: Timeout
entries.description: Execute child node, but only for a maximum duration.
entries.template: If [Action] fails to execute within specified time limit, interrupt the execution and stop it.

entries.label: ManualSelector
entries.description: Let a human operator choose at runtime which child node to execute.
entries.template: Ask the operator which of the following actions ([Actions]) to execute, then execute the selected [Action] and return its result.

entries.label: RoundRobin
entries.description: Execute child nodes one at a time in rotating order, resuming from the child after the one last executed on the previous tick.
entries.template: Execute the next action in the rotation ([Actions]). If [Action] succeeds, stop execution and continue from the following action next time. If [Action] fails, move to the next action. If all actions fail in one full rotation, the execution fails.

entries.label: IfThenElse
entries.description: Execute a condition child and, depending on its result, execute either the second or the third child node.
entries.template: If [Condition], execute [Action]. Else if [!Condition], execute the alternative [Action]. If no alternative is given, the execution fails.

entries.label: RateController
entries.description: Execute a child node at most at a given frequency.
entries.template: Execute [Action] at a fixed rate. If the specified period has not yet elapsed, wait before executing [Action] again.

entries.label: GoalUpdater
entries.description: Update the current goal before executing a child node.
entries.template: Check for a new goal. If a new goal is available, replace the current goal with it, then execute [Action].

entries.label: DistanceController
entries.description: Execute a child node each time the robot has travelled a given distance.
entries.template: Execute [Action] once the robot has moved the specified distance since the last execution. Else do not re-execute [Action].

entries.label: SpeedController
entries.description: Execute a child node at a frequency that scales with the robot's speed.
entries.template: Execute [Action] more often when the robot moves faster and less often when it moves slower, within a minimum and maximum rate.

entries.label: SubTree
entries.description: Execute another behavior tree referenced by its ID.
entries.template: Execute the subtree [Subtree ID] and return its result as if it were a single [Action].
